title: Eye of the Reaper
description: A surreal night scene features a giant cracked eyeball floating in a starry sky with red and blue nebulae. The green iris contains a small Grim Reaper figure, while green slime drips from the eye. Below, a black hooded Grim Reaper stands on a rock by a pond holding a red leash attached to the eye. A blue ghost with yellow eyes floats in the water among lily pads and small sailboats. Silhouetted figures dance near a large red moon in the background.

Silhouetted dancing figures appear near a large red moon in the background, vibrant colors, detailed illustration.
